subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress sub-agent announce

question: Should OpenClaw expose deterministic sub-agent completion suppression as a narrow per-spawn policy, a persistent default, or part of the broader completion-routing API?
rationale: Current behavior solves parent review but not enforced silence, while repository policy sets a high bar for new config and related open requests propose broader routing and per-channel policy surfaces.

options.title: Per-spawn policy first
options.body: Add a structured per-spawn `parent` versus `skip` policy, keep current behavior as default, and defer persistent or per-channel defaults until demand and naming stabilize.

options.title: Unified routing policy
options.body: Design one parent/channel/skip API jointly with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/27445 and close this issue only after deterministic skip ships within that contract.

options.title: Global and channel defaults
options.body: Add global and per-channel policy precedence now, accepting the larger config, migration, and documentation surface.

recommendation.title: Per-spawn policy first
recommendation.body: Add a structured per-spawn `parent` versus `skip` policy, keep current behavior as default, and defer persistent or per-channel defaults until demand and naming stabilize.

likelyOwner.reason: The history connects this person most strongly to the spawn contract, announce lifecycle, delivery architecture, and current documentation defining the product boundary.
